about.label: 01 / About
about.caption: The system decomposes into layers
about.s1: I build interfaces that scale from
about.p1a: I’m a senior front-end engineer working mostly in Vue and Nuxt, and comfortably in React and Next.js.
about.p1b: I care about the parts users never see — boundaries, state, rendering strategy — because they decide how the parts users do see will feel.
about.p2: I’ve been building front ends since 2020: a learning management system for Smart-Sino UK, an ERP for inspection companies at NCT, and most recently Tarazoo, a server-rendered legal platform on Next.js.

stack.label: 02 / Stack
stack.caption: Components become skills
stack.title: A connected system, not a progress bar.
stack.intro: Select a technology to see what it’s for, what it connects to, and where it has shipped.

d.ts: The contract layer. Typed props, stores and API boundaries keep large codebases refactorable.
d.js: The runtime underneath everything — and knowing where it gets expensive.
d.html: Semantic structure and modern CSS. Layout, motion and accessibility start here.
d.vue: Primary framework. Composition API, composables and component design that scales across teams.
d.nuxt: Primary meta-framework. Hybrid rendering, layers and modules for products that need speed, SEO and structure.
d.react: Second home. Hooks, server components and the patterns that transfer between ecosystems.
d.next: App Router, streaming and server-first data for React products.
d.tw: Utility-first styling backed by design tokens, so themes and systems stay consistent.
d.arch: Boundaries, state ownership, rendering strategy and performance budgets — the decisions that outlive components.
d.vuetify: Material Design component framework for Vue, providing ready-to-use UI components and design consistency.

tarazoo.summary: The front end of Tarazoo, a server-rendered legal-consultation platform: people browse legal services, ask questions with AI assistance, and book paid sessions with lawyers.
tarazoo.body: Built on the Next.js App Router as a set of modules with clear ownership: TanStack Query for server state, Redux Toolkit for client state, and NextAuth for OTP sign-in. Everything is styled with a custom design system on Tailwind CSS 4 and Radix UI, shipped with Docker and Nginx, and watched in production by Sentry with structured logging.
highlights: A page builder that renders configurable blocks (hero, services, benefits, FAQ, workflow, blog and news, comments) from backend-driven data.
An AI-assisted legal question flow, and lawyer reservation and booking with integrated payment.
Robust forms on React Hook Form and Zod, with schema validation across sign-in, questions and reservations.
alt: Tarazoo home page: the legal platform introduction next to the AI legal assistant card

Light and dark themes, a language switch and live notifications across the whole app.

ika.summary: IKA, an ERP for inspection companies: one workspace for the people, contracts and inspections behind every job.
ika.body: The app is organised around the inspection business itself: users, customers, coordinators and inspectors, with nested sections for contracts and inspections. It also runs the office around the work (correspondence, a file manager, the monthly menu and staff food reservation), so teams stay in one tool instead of five.
highlights: Management screens for users, customers, coordinators and inspectors, plus nested contract and inspection sections.
Back-office modules in the same app: correspondence, file manager, monthly menu and food reservation.
Light and dark themes, a language switch and live notifications across the whole app.
